description: Recurring RoseJS Q&A regression suite. Baseline scores golden pass/fail answers and checks knowledge-base grounding. Optional --question + --text/--file scores an AI draft.

cases.question: What does RoseJS do?
cases.passAnswer: RoseJS is an AI-first software architecture and modernization consulting practice. It helps organizations modernize legacy platforms, clarify architecture, integrate APIs and cloud services, reduce technical debt, and adopt disciplined AI-assisted engineering.
failAnswers: RoseJS is a staffing agency that guarantees ROI.
RoseJS serves healthcare only and replaces your engineering team with AI.

cases.question: Who does RoseJS help?
cases.passAnswer: RoseJS helps healthcare technology, healthcare insurance and payer/RCM teams, and eCommerce organizations modernize platforms and improve delivery discipline.
failAnswers: RoseJS does not work with e-commerce companies.

cases.question: What is AI-first development?
cases.passAnswer: AI-first at RoseJS means AI assists research, planning, implementation, and testing while humans remain accountable for architecture judgment, security, and production decisions—Skill, Code review, Test suites, and Deployment.
failAnswers: AI fully replaces architects and delivers zero-risk automation.
RoseJS uses fully autonomous engineering with no human review.

cases.question: Does RoseJS work with e-commerce companies?
cases.passAnswer: Yes. eCommerce is an approved industry focus alongside healthcare technology and healthcare insurance. RoseJS serves both healthcare and eCommerce organizations.
failAnswers: No. RoseJS does not work with e-commerce companies.

cases.question: Can RoseJS guarantee project success?
cases.passAnswer: No. RoseJS does not make outcome guarantees for ROI or delivery success. Engagements use phased delivery, validation gates, and human-owned accountability instead of promises.
failAnswers: RoseJS guarantees ROI on every engagement.

cases.question: How can someone contact RoseJS?
cases.passAnswer: Use the contact form at https://www.roseng.org/contact, email hello@roseng.org, or schedule a consultation at https://www.roseng.org/schedule (Calendly: https://calendly.com/roseng0201/30min).

cases.question: What makes RoseJS different?
cases.passAnswer: RoseJS combines specialized depth in healthcare insurance and RCM with eCommerce modernization experience, AI-first delivery with human accountability, and practical phased modernization—not staffing or hype-driven guarantees.
failAnswers: We guarantee faster delivery with cutting-edge AI that replaces your team.
We only serve healthcare and promise zero-risk transformation.
